en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Al Ghifary, from Ja’far Bin Ibrahim who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who sees the place (effect) of his speech on his deeds, would be scarce in his speech, except regarding what is meaningful’.
en.sarwar: 19. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Bakr ibn Salih form al-Ghaffari from Ja’far ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) say, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “If one can realize the effect of his words on his deeds, his words will decrease except for what he needs.’”
